views.label: Three dimensions
views.settings: $\ell = 1$, $m = -1$ before the shell and $m = 1$ after it.
caption: A thin shell of light falling into anti-de Sitter space of three dimensions, each point in the diagram a circle. The event horizon leaves the centre at $cv = -\pi\ell/2$ and meets the shell at $r = \ell$.
legend: $r = 0$, a singularity of the causal structure
